title: Pamaal ran mein hogaya noushahe karbala
body:
pamaal ran mein hogaya noushahe karbala
1. aayi jo ran se qasim -e- bekas ki yeh sada
waqt madad hain aayiye ab aayiye chacha
shabbir sar ko peet ke karte the buka
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. qasim hume bulate hain abbas hain kaha
goonji sada hussain ki tharaya aasman
akbar se roke kehte the yeh shah -e- insoja
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. suraj pe ahle shaam ka nargha hain aye pisar
dhonde kidhar sitam ke andhere mein yeh nazar
awaaz sun rahe hain falak se yeh hum sada
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. mausam bahar ka tha fizza kaisi chagayi
yeh zindagi ke din yeh ajal kaisi aagayi
tera baras ka sin tha abhi yeh sitam huwa
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. maqtal ki sar zameen pe dekha yeh majra
tukde badan ke bikhra the qasim ke jabaja
abbas se yeh kehte the bhai yeh kya huwa
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. maqtal ki gard oodh ke qasim jo sogaye
armaan zindagi ke sabhi khaak hogaye
dulhan ke lab pe tha yehi nauha basad buka
<<MINI>>
paamal ran mein hogaya . . . . .
